name: recipientName
description: What to call them: their own name, or their first name from the customer record

name: accessCode
description: The six digits they type into the page they already have open. Never a link: a clickable one would be spent by the first mail scanner or preview bot that touches the message

name: expiryMinutes
description: How many minutes the code is good for

name: tripName
description: The trip this code opens, so somebody with two bookings knows which one

name: portalUrl
description: Their trip page, for the case where they came to the email first. Blank when no portal address is configured
